title: Canonical coordinate predicates for normalized point Frobenius transport
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from D.p, and a finite extension E of Q_l. Put s = Spec D.k and g = the specified geometric Frobenius of s. Use the actual finite pullback, inverse image and tensor-unit comparison of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], and the reduction/limit calculus and whole-cone comparisons of [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback-comparison-normalization]. Define finiteComplex and integralComplex by the degree-zero single functor; finiteKappa is the specified comparison, and finiteLambda localizes the inverse multiplication isomorphism with both exact-functor factorization comparisons. The identity direct images are fixed by right-adjoint uniqueness. At integral level use the actual completion unit and its inverse on complete objects, with inverseOrZero extending only the ambient formula. FiniteNormalization, IntegralQuotientNormalization, IntegralNormalization and TensorDualNormalization are the explicit coordinate predicates of the original point normalization statement. The rational and closed extensions are the recorded scalar extension functors of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. All 26 definitions are copied verbatim from the original module; no mathematical object or map changes.
